title: Figures 5.7-5.8: Three-unit MCSA device and belt-cusp fields with particle recirculation
description: Two physics diagrams. 'Figure 5.7. Illustration of a Three-Unit MCSA Device' shows blue confined plasma lobes along an axis within a solenoid coil and 'Floating (Hemholtz) Field Coils'. 'Figure 5.8. Diagram of Belt-Cusp Fields and Particle Recirculation' plots magnetic field lines around coil cross-sections with pink plasma regions and a red 'Recirculation Particle Trajectory (red)', under the heading 'Recirculation of Radial Belt Cone Losses'.
